remarks:
The perfect Village of Ellicottville location with easy access to shops, restaurants, and local attractions. This
ground-floor unit was originally two smaller units that have been thoughtfully combined into one beautifully remodeled condo, now offering 3 bedrooms and 2½ baths. Enjoy direct access from the rear of the unit to the shared courtyard — ideal for entertaining — along with use of the community hot tub and laundry facilities. One tandem parking spaces next to the unit allow you to park your car and enjoy your entire Village stay on foot. The layout also offers flexibility, as the condo can be separated back into two individual units: one featuring bedrooms and 1½ baths, and the other offering 1 bedroom, 1 bath, and a small kitchenette — perfect for guests or long term rental potential. Historic character shines through with original brick walls and horse tie-offs dating back to the early 1900s. Personal items are excluded, and the property is being sold mostly furnished. Don’t miss the opportunity to see this special property — a rare find in the Village right downtown. HOA payments are billed every four months. Two units connected selling as 1 property. Other tax map # is 043601-055-035-0005-013-001. NO short term rentals! Taxes are based off both units.
